# Source and rewrite note

- Repository: <https://github.com/lvlh2/alpha101>
- Pinned commit: `b6bd3f4fb53fdf62a9f8454c477561651f764952`
- Original file: <https://github.com/lvlh2/alpha101/blob/b6bd3f4fb53fdf62a9f8454c477561651f764952/src/alpha101/alphas.py>
- License: MIT, copyright 2026 lvlh2. License text: <https://github.com/lvlh2/alpha101/blob/b6bd3f4fb53fdf62a9f8454c477561651f764952/LICENSE>

`formulas.py` retains only the expressions for Alpha #6, #12, #33, and #101, expressed on wide pandas panels. The package class, operator library, unsupported factors, installation path, and batch API are omitted.

These are controls, not the recommended first rewrite. The old local pack already contained #6/#12/#101, and `ref_github_strats` used that family before drifting to small-cap code. A Fold should first validate a mechanism from the four-item rewrite order in `playbook.md`.

If used as an operator test, rebuild the formula directly in `output/main.py`, group by symbol over a bounded T-1 tail, and confirm the intended time-series versus cross-sectional rank semantics. Never import this reference file.
